sections.title: Predicate logic
sections.description: First-order predicate calculus with typed domain, Bernays rules, substitution, and eigenvariable conditions.

entries.title: Discourse domain is non-empty
entries.notes: Layered axiomatization: Section 2 axiomatizes pure First-Order Predicate Logic over sort Class prior to Section 3 (Class Comprehension). In multi-sorted / inclusive predicate logic (where some sorts like Nonstored / Void are uninhabited), 2.01 explicitly postulates that the sort Class is inhabited so (∀(K : Class) φ) → (∃(K : Class) φ) holds in pure predicate logic; once Section 3's Class Comprehension Axiom (3.01) is added, 2.01 becomes derivable (witnessed by ∅).

entries.title: Forall Instantiation (FI)
entries.notes: Term t is free for substitution for variable identifier v_x in formula φ.

entries.title: Exists Instantiation (EI)
entries.notes: Witness substitution into existential quantifier.

entries.title: Forall Abstraction (FA / Bernays)
entries.notes: Eigenvariable condition: variable identifier v_x does not occur free in antecedent ψ or context Γ.

entries.title: Exists Abstraction (EA / Bernays)
entries.notes: Dual eigenvariable condition: v_x not free in consequent ψ or assumptions.

entries.title: Generalisation (Gen)
entries.notes: Universal generalization over variable identifier v_x not free in active context Γ.

sections.title: Set/class-theoretic foundations of mathematics
sections.description: Morse–Kelley (MK) axiomatic class theory with Dunaev tagged ordered pairs, class comprehension, class conditional if-then-else, simple_if, if_dep, and Ordinal Induction.

entries.title: Class Comprehension Axiom
entries.notes: Predicative/impredicative comprehension for all first-order and higher-order formulas. Lowercase x, y are used by naming convention because elements of classes must be sets (isSet(x)).

entries.title: Extensionality Axiom
entries.semantic: ∀(A, B : Class) ((∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ A) ⟷ (x ∈ B))) → (A = B))
entries.notes: Two classes having identical elements are identical.
entries.interpretation_code: ∀(A, B : Class) ((∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ A) ⟷ (x ∈ B))) → (A = B))
entries.semantic_typing: ∀(A, B : Class) ((∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ A) ⟷ (x ∈ B))) → (A = B))
entries.interpretation_model_latex: \forall A, B \; ((\forall x \; ((x \in A) \longleftrightarrow (x \in B))) \to (A = B))
entries.semantic_membership_latex: \forall A, B \; ((\forall x \; ((x \in A) \longleftrightarrow (x \in B))) \to (A = B))

entries.title: Heredity Axiom (Subclasses of Sets are Sets)
entries.notes: Any subclass A of a set b is a set.

entries.title: Regularity (Foundation) Axiom
entries.notes: Every non-empty class A contains an ∈-minimal set element x. Rules out infinite descending ∈-chains.

entries.title: Pairing Axiom
entries.notes: Unordered pair of two sets is a set.

entries.title: Union Axiom
entries.notes: The unary union of any set a is a set.

entries.title: IF-THEN-ELSE-FI (Class conditional with NFV side condition and context turnstile)
entries.semantic: W, Γ ⊢ (⟦IF ψ THEN A ELSE B FI⟧ = { v | ((ψ ∧ (v ∈ A)) ∨ (¬ψ ∧ (v ∈ B))) })
entries.notes: Class-level conditional defined via class comprehension. The syntactic constructor IF-THEN-ELSE-FI denotes a class valuation ⟦IF ψ THEN A ELSE B FI⟧. Soundness requires variable identifier v_v not free in formula ψ or context Γ.

entries.notes: Transfinite induction over the class of ordinals (On : Class). Lowercase x, y are used as a readable naming convention because x ∈ On and y ∈ x are sets. entries.title: Power Class Definition (𝒫(A))
entries.program: (* CpPower constructor in typetheory.ML line 514: 𝒫(A) = { x | (isSet(x) ∧ (x ⊆ A)) } *)
entries.notes: Defines the power class operator 𝒫(A) = { x | x ⊆ A } (kernel constructor CpPower in typetheory.ML). For any class A (proper class or set), 𝒫(A) is the class of all sets x that are subclasses of A; Axiom 3.34 then postulates that whenever a is a set, 𝒫(a) is also a set.

entries.title: Power Set Axiom (Power Class of a Set is a Set)

entries.title: Replacement / Limitation of Size Axiom

entries.title: Syntactic Encoding Operator (Enc)
entries.notes: Gödel / Hereditarily-Finite-Set encoding (CpEnc in typetheory.ML). Quantified at the metalevel over syntactic type expressions T_e : Type_Expression; maps any finite syntactic object s : ⟦T_e⟧ (Fm, Ctx, Theory, Stmt, Prf) into a finite set code in V_ω ⊂ V, so isSet(Enc(s)) is always true.

entries.title: Syntactic Decoding & Roundtrip Law (Dec)
entries.notes: Partial syntactic decoder (VDec in typetheory.ML) quantified at the metalevel over syntactic type expressions T_e : Type_Expression. Inverts Enc(s) on the carrier Emb(⟦T_e⟧), decoupled from antiquotation brackets ⟦...⟧ so that antiquoting a proper class X does not force isSet(X).

entries.title: Dual Type Embedding Operator (Emb)

entries.title: Proof-Object Class Family (ProofsOf)
entries.notes: Maps an encoded statement Enc(s) (or formula Enc(φ)) to the class of all encoded verified proof objects witnessing it: ProofsOf : Fm → 𝒫(Proofs). Reconciles Variant 2 typing (p : ProofsOf(φ)) with Variant 1 membership (Enc(p) ∈ ProofsOf(Enc(s))).

entries.title: Class of Provable Statements (Theorems)
entries.notes: First-order class of all encoded provable statements in NBG/MK. An encoded statement Enc(s) belongs to Theorems if and only if there exists an encoded proof witness p ∈ ProofsOf(Enc(s)).
